Rules.InvariantScript: Notify("This button will navigate you to the environment section",NotificationType.Information)

Rule.InvariantScript:
( CountRows(
    Filter(
        colInventoryColumns,
        visible,
        section = "General"
    )
) * 40) + 32 + Self.LayoutGap + (Self.PaddingLeft + Self.PaddingRight)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Sort(
    Filter(
        colInventoryColumns,
        visible,
        section = "General"
    ),
    order,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)
